thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the throughput/latency regression — we need a concrete action grid for SLO/SLA updates and dashboard ownership.

devops-bot: [incident-summary] 3 occurrences of tail-latency spikes over past 14 days, correlated with bursty batch loads.

tom: Thanks. Can someone paste the recurrence query? want to see windows and counts.

maya: query pasted below (kibana):
```
index=production-logs service=inference | timechart span=1h p95(latency_ms) p99(latency_ms) by pool
```

rachel: I'll own the dashboard. Plan: add p50/p95/p99, throughput by pool, and an alert for p95>450ms for 5m. ETA 2 working days. @maya assign if that's ok.

maya: assign rachel -> thanks. also need an action on SLO thresholds: current SLO is p95 < 300ms, we breached twice last month. proposal: move p95 SLO to 350ms for bursty pools and add a throughput SLO (qps/sec per pool).

kevin: +1 on throughput SLO. For Dedicated pools we should have a soft SLO: 95th percentile throughput >= x% of provisioned capacity. we can compute from prometheus: `sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (pool)` vs provisioned_gpus.

olivia: Who owns the remediation? We need a runbook: autoscale policy tweaks, pre-warming, and KV cache TTL examination. I can draft the runbook if someone owns rollout.

maya: olivia please draft runbook. kevin to prototype throughput SLO query and suggest numeric target by EOD Tue (48h). rachel to deliver dashboard by Fri COB.

tom: I'll add a synthetic load test to reproduce spike pattern and verify fix. ETA next Tue.

devops-bot: Action items recorded: 1) dashboard -> rachel (due 1743720000), 2) throughput SLO query -> kevin (due 1743543589), 3) runbook draft -> olivia (due 1743520000), 4) synthetic test -> tom (due 1743543589).

rachel: Quick note on alerts: prefer creating a composite alert that triggers only when p95>450ms AND qps>threshold to reduce noise. Will include threshold suggestions on the dashboard page.

kevin: For SLO math, recommendation: keep service-level objective at p95<300ms for hosted tiers, but use a tiered SLA guarantee for Dedicated: p95<350ms with explicit burst allowance (error budget spend window=30d). I'll attach numbers in the SLO PR.

maya: Good. One more: updating public SLA wording — product/legal need a short blurb. I'll loop in product next.

olivia: I'll start the runbook draft now. planning sections: detection, immediate mitigations, rollback triggers, and long-term fixes.

tom: If anyone needs the synthetic harness I already have a branch. ping me and I'll grant access.

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Wed 10am to review dashboard + SLO PR. If owners hit blockers, update this thread. :thumbsup:
